say:1:1641127001:0.text: Hey, want to see something from my secret stash?
say:1:1641127001:0.source_cn: 我来给你看一个超级秘密收藏！
say:1:1641127001:0.male: Hey, want to see something from my secret stash?
say:1:1641127001:0.female: Hey, want to see something from my secret stash?

say:2:1641127002:1.text: Tada! Pinecones. Yep. A whole lot, actually!
say:2:1641127002:1.source_cn: 就是这些——松塔！没错，全都是松塔！
say:2:1641127002:1.male: Tada! Pinecones. Yep. A whole lot, actually!
say:2:1641127002:1.female: Tada! Pinecones. Yep. A whole lot, actually!

say:3:1641127003:1.text: And before you say anything—they're important to me. This one's a bit dented, but if you tilt it just right, it looks like a crescent moon. See?
say:3:1641127003:1.source_cn: 别小看它们哦，这一颗长得稍微有点瘪，但你看，像不像月亮？
say:3:1641127003:1.male: And before you say anything—they're important to me. This one's a bit dented, but if you tilt it just right, it looks like a crescent moon. See?
say:3:1641127003:1.female: And before you say anything—they're important to me. This one's a bit dented, but if you tilt it just right, it looks like a crescent moon. See?

say:4:1641127004:1.text: This one's pointy, kind of like a little spear. And this one—my favorite—smells faintly of cocoa if you sniff it close!
say:4:1641127004:1.source_cn: 还有这一颗，尖尖的，像小矛头。唔……这一颗是我最喜欢的...
say:4:1641127004:1.male: This one's pointy, kind of like a little spear. And this one—my favorite—smells faintly of cocoa if you sniff it close!
say:4:1641127004:1.female: This one's pointy, kind of like a little spear. And this one—my favorite—smells faintly of cocoa if you sniff it close!

say:5:1641127005:1.text: I like to think they're silently watching over me. Like tiny forest charms.
say:5:1641127005:1.source_cn: 我觉得它们都在悄悄守护我，就像小小的护身符一样。
say:5:1641127005:1.male: I like to think they're silently watching over me. Like tiny forest charms.
say:5:1641127005:1.female: I like to think they're silently watching over me. Like tiny forest charms.

say:6:1641127006:1.text: I mean... I know they're just ordinary pinecones, but when I mess something up—and I always do—just holding one calms me down.
say:6:1641127006:1.source_cn: 虽、虽然它们都是普通的松塔，但是……当我又把事情弄砸的...
say:6:1641127006:1.male: I mean... I know they're just ordinary pinecones, but when I mess something up—and I always do—just holding one calms me down.
say:6:1641127006:1.female: I mean... I know they're just ordinary pinecones, but when I mess something up—and I always do—just holding one calms me down.

say:7:1641127007:1.text: So I don't care what anyone says. They're mine, and I'm keeping every single one of them safe!
say:7:1641127007:1.source_cn: 所以不管别人怎么说，我都会把它们好好收藏起来的！
say:7:1641127007:1.male: So I don't care what anyone says. They're mine, and I'm keeping every single one of them safe!
say:7:1641127007:1.female: So I don't care what anyone says. They're mine, and I'm keeping every single one of them safe!
